messages:
ellie: Heads up — noticed a flaky edge in the JS sampleapp onboarding flow. When token refresh triggers while prefetching next pages, the paginator sometimes re-requests the same cursor and we double-process items. Seen on macOS dev env and CI :thinking_face:

sam: repro steps? any logs?

ellie: quick repro: start sample app, enable prefetch window=2, force a 401 on the next request to trigger token refresh. Logs show the SDK issues the page request, token refresh kicks in, and then the page request is retried but with the old cursor still enqueued. Example log snippet:

```
fetch page cursor=abc123
auth: refresh started
retry fetch page cursor=abc123
fetch page cursor=abc123 -> processed twice
```

alex: sounds like a race: paginator advances its internal pointer before the auth retry flow resolves, so the retry uses stale state. JS SDK currently keeps cursor state mutable and doesn't block on auth middleware.

ellie: yep. Workarounds are messy in app code (dedupe by id, or make prefetch smaller), but we should fix in SDK and the sampleapp so onboarding doesn't confuse users.

tj: I can draft a small change — make the paginator hold the active cursor until request+auth completes, or attach an idempotency token to each page request. Which approach do we want for parity with Go/Python?

sam: Go SDK had similar but we chose 'hold-active-cursor' approach to avoid server support for idempotency. Python did a different patch last year (opt-in dedupe). We should pick one consistent strategy and document it.

alex: preference for hold-active-cursor in runtime: simple and predictable for developers. Impl notes: when prefetch spawns a request, mark cursor as in-flight; if auth refresh happens, pause cursor advancement and the retry uses same in-flight marker so we don't re-enqueue the same cursor. Also make sure cancellation still works.

ellie: sounds good. Can we get a small backwards-compatible opt-in flag in the SDK config (e.g., `paginator.stablePrefetch = true`) so we can flip in sampleapp and enable by default later?

tj: yeah I’ll open a PR with tests + sampleapp update. Will add an e2e that forces 401 during prefetch to assert no duplicates.

sam: also add a short spec doc in devex channel explaining behavior and how auth middleware should expose a promise hook. That will help ports.

ci-bot: sampleapp CI build started (job #4123)

ellie: awesome — thanks tj. once PR is up ping me and I’ll run onboarding tests. :thumbsup:

sam: fyi tagging @alex for SDK API review when PR lands.

ellie: filing follow-ups: 1) PR with hold-active-cursor + tests 2) sampleapp toggled to stablePrefetch 3) devex spec note and portability checklist.

tj: PR draft in a few hours.

ellie: great — keeping this thread for tracking.
